workDays.description: Calendar year {year} · calculated from confirmed payslips
workDays.rule: A day with more than 4 hours of work counts as a full day; up to 4 hours counts as a half day. Two half days equal one full day. Limit for non-EU students: 140 full days (or 280 half days) per calendar year. Separate limit during lecture periods: 20 hours per week.
